pages.preference.sounds.title: Sound effects
pages.preference.sounds.help: Click a key to preview its sound and choose an audio file. Hover to see the filename. Physical key presses play the assigned sound; bindings save automatically.
pages.preference.sounds.formats: WAV, MP3, Ogg Vorbis and FLAC, up to 64 MB. Independent of the selected model; key availability depends on input permission and keyboard layout.
pages.preference.sounds.pluginHint: Assign sounds to keyboard keys. A dedicated worker handles import, decoding, playback and saving. Disabling preserves bindings and audio files.
